simple.meaning: אֲרִידַי (ʼĂrîyday) is a Hebrew word meaning “Aridai , a son of Haman.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֲרִידַי (H742) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אֲרִידַי (H742) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אֲרִידַי (ʼĂrîyday) / H742 is traced through Esther 9:9 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H742. Ariday אֲרִידַי proper name, masculine a son of Haman Est 9:9 (Persian, perhaps = haridayas, delight of Hari , see Add Thes 72 ; but text very uncertain; compare different tradition as to the names in ᵐ5 ).
